theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P), IsOpen U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → ∀ᵐ w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl n)), Φ w ∈ U → DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w
